identityScope: Four catalog rows that previously had no field review were reviewed against current Hiwonder shop pages. TonyPi, JetAuto, AiNova and PuppyPi are four separate current models; the TonyPi Pro kit is a 20 DOF variant of the same model and is recorded in the DOF field rather than merged into a separate row. The reviewed pages publish current shop prices, so the catalog 590, 440, 86 and 700 USD values are replaced. The PuppyPi catalog ~1.5 kg mass, ~2 hours battery, 120 min runtime and small size label are replaced by the reviewed 720 g mass, 7.4 V 2,200 mAh battery and dimensions. The TonyPi catalog 590 USD price and small size label are replaced by 599.99 USD and the reviewed dimensions. No new model was created and no company focus was added because Hiwonder is not a source company with a company-authored focus.

fields.handType: Two robotic hands; 18 DOF humanoid robot
fields.description: The Hiwonder TonyPi is an 18 DOF humanoid robot built on a Raspberry Pi 5 with 16 bus servos in the body and a 2 DOF HD-camera head. It measures 373 x 186 x 106 mm and weighs about 1.8 kg. An 11.1 V 2,000 mAh battery provides about 60 min working time. The Pro Kit raises the configuration to 20 DOF and adds movable robotic hands that open to 66 mm; the standard and advanced kits have 18 DOF. It costs 599.99 USD. No payload, travel speed, IP rating or charging time is published; the catalog 590 USD price and small size label are replaced by the reviewed price and dimensions.

fields.description: The Hiwonder PuppyPi is an 8 DOF quadruped robot built on a Raspberry Pi 4B or 5 with coreless servos and a 3 DOF robotic arm. It measures 226 x 149 x 190 mm and weighs 720 g. A 7.4 V 2,200 mAh LiPo battery powers the robot; no runtime in minutes or charging time is published. It supports ROS1 and ROS2, Python, a 480P camera and app or wireless-handle control, and the arm adds colour recognition, target tracking and object transport. It costs 589.99 USD. No payload, travel speed or IP rating is published; the catalog 700 USD price, ~1.5 kg mass, small size label, ~2 hours battery and 120 min runtime are replaced or cleared.

source-integrity-check.inspection: Native HTML read as text only. No research browser, visual inspection, OCR or media reuse. No login, forms, contact, messages or transactions.

body-scope-check.versionScopes: TonyPi, JetAuto, AiNova and PuppyPi are four separate current Hiwonder products. TonyPi is a humanoid, PuppyPi a quadruped with a robotic arm, and JetAuto and AiNova are wheeled robot cars. The TonyPi Pro kit is a 20 DOF variant of the same model and is noted in the DOF field instead of being merged into a separate row.
body-scope-check.priceScopes: Current shop prices are 599.99 USD for TonyPi, 439.99 USD for JetAuto, 85.99 USD for AiNova and 589.99 USD for PuppyPi. The catalog 590, 440, 86 and 700 USD values are not substituted for these reviewed prices.
body-scope-check.weightScopes: Product net weights are about 1800 g for TonyPi, 3500 g for JetAuto, about 0.5 kg for AiNova and 720 g for PuppyPi. Package weights are separate and are not recorded as robot mass.
body-scope-check.sizeScopes: Product dimensions are 373 x 186 x 106 mm for TonyPi, 302 x 260 x 256 mm for JetAuto, 172 x 140 x 146 mm for AiNova and 226 x 149 x 190 mm for PuppyPi. Package dimensions are separate.
body-scope-check.payloadScopes: No reviewed page publishes a payload rating; these are educational robots and robot cars without a load rating.
body-scope-check.enduranceScopes: Battery packs are 11.1 V 2,000 mAh for TonyPi, 11.1 V 6,000 mAh for JetAuto, 1,200 mAh 18650 for AiNova and 7.4 V 2,200 mAh for PuppyPi. TonyPi and JetAuto publish about 60 min working time; AiNova and PuppyPi publish no runtime in minutes and no charging time.
body-scope-check.autonomyScopes: TonyPi publishes 18 DOF and a 2 DOF head; PuppyPi publishes 8 DOF and a 3 DOF arm; JetAuto and AiNova are wheeled robot cars. These are manufacturer descriptions, not independent safety certification or proof of unsupervised operation.
body-scope-check.listingScopes: The roboticsdir and buyandrentrobots listings name products and companies; they do not establish prices, current stock, delivered fleets or independent performance.

comparison-evidence-check.scope: Exact claim/source/status delivery; runtime tests separately verify comparison rendering and load behavior.

reimport-check.scope: Importer leaves every tracked data byte unchanged. Offline refresh may update only generation/comparison timestamps and the digest of timestamp-bearing coverage.
